SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. ...AG...Y No. S. I. D. 7855 Date April 2, 1937.）

Subject Shanghai First Special District Court Warrant No.1642
issued at the request of the Police Bureau
Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by J. Boyne. O.S.I.

At 12.40 p.m. April 2, 1937, members of the Special
Branch accompanied by detectives from Central Station and
representatives of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau
and the Bureau of Social Affairs visited the Wu Zoe Vung Hwo
Voh Wu Dzo ( 互助文化服務社 ) situated in an upstairs
room of House No.3, Lane 217 Hankow Road, for the purpose of
executing Search Warrant No.1642 issued by the Shanghai First
Special District Court at the request of the Police Bureau to
search and seize certain reactionary publications entitled
"Ngoo Mung Ti S Ka" (Wo Mnde Abgie) ( 我們的出路 ).
Upon arrival, the room was found locked and a paper
slip posted on the door of the room stating that the "society"
was temporarily closed owing to financial difficulties.
Enquiries made from Chief Tenant Wong Chai-an
( 王介安 ) revealed that the occupant of the room was one
named Fang ( 方 ), who had left the room about one week ago.
The matter was explained to the representatives of
the Police Bureau and the Bureau of Social Affairs, and they
stated that they will make further enquiries regarding the
whereabouts of the occupant.
The warrant is therefore returned for cancellation.

（批：Returned 3-4-37 (11 am) O.S.I.）

McKeown
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch).

The following formed the Police party :-
D.S. Wright, D.S. McKeown, D.S. Larby
Clerk Loh Wei-kong C.D.S.219, 141.

事由 上海第一特区地方法院 第1642号搜查令
应警察局请求签发
由警佐 McKeown 制作 经由首席政治部警官 J. Boyne 转呈。

1937年4月2日下午12时40分，政治部成员在中央捕房侦探以及上海市政府警察局和社会局代表的陪同下，前往位于汉口路217弄3号楼上房间的“互助文化服務社”（Wu Zoe Vung Hwo Voh Wu Dzo），目的是执行上海第一特区地方法院应警察局请求签发的第1642号搜查令，以搜查并扣押某些名为“Ngoo Mung Ti S Ka” (Wo Mnde Abgie)（我們的出路）的反动出版物。
到达后，发现房间已上锁，门上贴有一张纸条，称该“社”因财务困难暂时关闭。
向二房东王介安（Wong Chai-an）查询后得知，房间居住者是一名姓方（Fang）的人，约于一周前离开。
此事已向警察局和社会局代表说明，他们表示将进一步查询居住者的下落。
因此，退回搜查令予以注销。

（批：1937年4月3日退回（上午11时） 首席政治部警官）

McKeown
警佐
侦探长（政治部）。

档案 / Obx 4月3日.

Subject Shanghai First Special District Court Search Warrant No.1640
issued at the request of the Police Bureau
Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

At 12.20 p.m. April 2, members of the Special Branch
accompanied by detectives from Central Station and
representatives of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau
and the Bureau of Social Affairs visited the Sing Tsong Koh
Book Company (新中國), 300 Foochow Road, for the purpose
of executing Search Warrant No.1640 issued by Judge Feng of
the Shanghai First Special District Court at the request of
the Police Bureau to search and seize a certain reactionary
publication entitled "Sung Vung Z Tsz Su Khe," (新文家清刊).
As the manager Van Yuin-loh (范中六) was absent,
the Search Warrant was shown to the shop assistant Tsang
Yung-keng (張榮根).
No such reactionary publication as mentioned in the
Warrant was found at this address.
The warrant is therefore returned for cancellation.

（左侧批注：Returned 3-4-37 (11 am) O.B.D）

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
-:- Assistance to Chinese Authorities -:-

At 12.50 p.m. 2-4-37, D.S. McKeown attached to Headquarters Special Branch, came to the Station together with Tsze Chiao Toong (朱校東) and Zee Wei Sing (徐曼心) attached to the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau Headquarters and requested assistance to search the Koh Tsi (國際) Bookstore, Foochow Road for reactionary literature, they being possession of S.S.D. Court Search Warrant No.1641 issued by Judge Feng at the request of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau.

Assistance was rendered by the undersigned and C.D.C.342 and the above premises visited and searched, this resulting in the following reactionary publications being located and seized, same being on display for sale:
(1) 70 copies of "Koh Na Sing Vung (國難新聞)".
(2) 2 copies of "Yoh Sung Pao Dau (學生報道)".

Zau Nan Koong (趙南公), proprietor of the Koh Tsi Bookstore, when questioned stated that these publications had been distributed by the Wu Zoo Vung Hoo Voh Vu Zoo (互助文化服務社), House 3 Lane 371 Hankow Road.

The above described papers will be taken before the S.S.D. Court on the 3-4-37 when application will be made for their disposal.

调查记录。
-:- 协助中国当局 -:-

1937年4月2日下午12时50分，隶属于总部政治部的警佐 McKeown 与隶属于上海市政府警察局总部的朱校東（Tsze Chiao Toong）和徐曼心（Zee Wei Sing）一同来到捕房，请求协助搜查福州路的国际书店（Koh Tsi）以查找反动文献，他们持有上海第一特区地方法院冯法官应上海市政府警察局请求签发的第1641号搜查令。

由下述人员和 C.D.C.342 提供协助，并对上述处所进行了访问和搜查，结果发现并扣押了以下正在陈列出售的反动出版物：
(1) 70本《國難新聞》（Koh Na Sing Vung）。
(2) 2本《學生報道》（Yoh Sung Pao Dau）。

国际书店店主赵南公（Zau Nan Koong）在接受询问时表示，这些出版物是由位于汉口路371弄3号的互助文化服務社（Wu Zoo Vung Hoo Voh Vu Zoo）分发的。

上述文件将于1937年4月3日提交至第二特区地方法院，届时将申请对其进行处理。
